'''Rohrwacher''' is a cautious Fisalia member [[NPC]] who appears outside the [[Cathedral of Mercury]]. He can be seen standing next to an [[Abyssal Mercator]] at the lounge area from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM and underneath the Cathedral by the [[Sentinel]] statue at 6:00 PM to 5:59 AM.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
;(At night, by the Sentinel statue underneath the Cathedral)
:'''Rohrwacher:''' Hail Imperator-
:'''Rohrwacher:''' You who watch over Ragunna at all times, overseeing the people of Ragunna.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' I have an audacious request- please, look up, look up at the Order sitting on you.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' Ah, why won't you look up? Is it that you don't wish to, or that you simply can't? Ahahahahaha..
:'''Rohrwacher:''' ...O Imperator... You are not the Imperator I remembered. 
----
;{{Spoiler}}
;(After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}
:'''Rohrwacher:''' Hail Imperator—
:'''Rohrwacher:''' So you have already perished. Your gaze no longer watches over the people of Ragunna.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' You cannot look upon the Order, nor can you watch over your people.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' Haha... Hahahaha...
:'''Rohrwacher:''' O Imperator! Let us offer you a solemn, eternal farewell!

==Dialogue==
:'''Rohrwacher:''' My friend from afar, I see you're getting close to the Montellis.
:{{DIcon}} How did you know?
:'''Rohrwacher:''' Even though Fisalia has been quiet, we still have ears everywhere.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' But I want to give you a heads-up—don't trust them too much.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' They're driven by money, measuring everything by what it's worth, even "talent" is just another commodity in their eyes, something to be stored in their vault.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' They don't share the deep family values and bonds we cherish. A tower built on gold isn't just unrespectable; it's also fragile and prone to fall apart.
:{{DIcon}} But the people I know from the Montelli family don't seem to think that way...
:'''Rohrwacher:''' It's best to keep your distance. Getting caught up in our drama isn't worth it. You should always look after your own interests.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' We all have roles we must see through, but you shouldn't be part of the play, nor just a spectator in the audience.
:'''Rohrwacher:''' You should go behind the scenes and find the one who's pulling the strings.
{{Dialogue End}}
